intro: Lunch and dinner from the open kitchen: French classics such as tartare, snails, onion soup and Coq au Vin, alongside seasonal dishes and house-made brioche. With the menu comes a wine list of Serbian, regional and international wines, and cocktails from our bar.

highlights.name: Escargot Bourguignon
highlights.description: Burgundy-style snails, garlic and parsley butter, brioche

highlights.name: French onion soup
highlights.description: French onion soup with Gruyère and house-made brioche

highlights.name: Coq au Vin
highlights.description: Rooster leg braised in Prokupac, Joël Robuchon-style mash, bacon, root vegetables, mushrooms, wine sauce

allergens: For allergen information and special requests (vegetarian, gluten-free), please ask our staff. We are happy to adapt a dish.
